content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To maintain a budget for personal use, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Categorize all cash expenses from the last week (1 hour)
Step 2. Download bank statements for the current month (10 minutes)
Step 3. Research high-yield savings account rates (2 hours)
Step 4. Identify recurring monthly subscriptions (30 minutes)
Step 5. Transfer surplus funds to a savings account (15 minutes)
Step 6. Calculate total grocery spending (45 minutes)
Step 7. Reconcile credit card balances with receipts (2 hours)
Step 8. Compare food spending against the monthly limit (20 minutes)
Step 9. Audit automatic bill payments (1 hour)
Step 10. Gather all physical receipts from the wallet (5 minutes)
Step 11. Draft a preliminary budget for next month (3 hours)
Step 12. Check current investment portfolio performance (1 hour)
Step 13. Set a specific savings goal for a vacation (30 minutes)
Step 14. Review utility bill trends over the last year (2 hours)
Step 15. Update the net worth spreadsheet (40 minutes)
Step 16. Request a free annual credit report (15 minutes)
Step 17. Allocate funds for upcoming annual insurance premiums (30 minutes)
Step 18. Scan receipts into a digital archive (1 hour)
Step 19. Cancel unused streaming services (20 minutes)
Step 20. Meet with a financial advisor (90 minutes)
Step 21. Adjust the discretionary spending allowance (15 minutes)
Step 22. Calculate the average cost of commuting (45 minutes)
Step 23. Log restaurant and dining out costs (30 minutes)
Step 24. Finalize the monthly debt repayment plan (1 hour)
Step 25. Determine the emergency fund target balance (1 hour)
Step 26. Review income tax withholdings (2 hours)
Step 27. Estimate upcoming holiday gift expenses (1 hour)
Step 28. Set up a dedicated "sinking fund" for car repairs (20 minutes)
Step 29. Write down long-term financial objectives (2 hours)
Step 30. Sort receipts by tax-deductible categories (1 hour)
Step 31. Total up all miscellaneous "fun money" purchases (30 minutes)
Step 32. Install a new budgeting mobile app (10 minutes)
Step 33. Review the final budget with a spouse or partner (1 hour)
Step 34. Purchase a monthly transit pass (5 minutes)
Step 35. Open a new sub-savings account for specific goals (30 minutes)
Step 36. Evaluate the previous month's overspending (2 hours)
Step 37. Export payroll data from the employer portal (15 minutes)
Step 38. Collect all outstanding invoices for freelance work (1 hour)
Step 39. Analyze the credit report for errors (1 hour)
Step 40. Set aside cash for weekly tips and small errands (10 minutes)
